name: Badland
description: Not many Pokémon can eke out a living in the badlands. Harsh weather, barren and rocky soil, and few trees for shelter make these areas tough to survive in. Though many types are represented, few are particularly abundant; resilient Steel- and Ground-types stand out from the rest, though Dark-, Dragon-, and even Flying-types appear as well. In such wastelands, only the scrappiest Pokémon can truly survive.
